text:
Nora (Partnerships): Quick thread to align on a "lean launch" packaging bundle for cloud marketplaces (AWS/GCP/Azure). We want a minimal bundle that passes vendor preflight but keeps options open for Dedicated/Private upsells. Key unknowns: canonical SKU list, trial mechanics across clouds, and whether we need region-gated images for export-controlled assets. Goal: staging push next Fri.

Vik (Cloud Ops): I'll provision staging publisher IDs unless Partnerships prefers vendor accounts. Staging IDs: aws-stg-321, gcp-stg-654, azure-stg-210. Need a list of emails for marketplace-admin for each tenant. Also: confirm image format (AMI, GCP Image, Azure VHD) and whether we publish a container image instead of AMI for simpler cross-cloud packaging.

Priya (Legal): Please attach the current EULA snippet and the telemetry/data-retention summary. Legal blockers to check now: export classification of model weights; PII in logs; and whether trial SKUs will create chargebacks (some clouds bill differently for trials). If telemetry contains org identifiers, we need a DPA addendum and region-specific retention rules.

Marco (Product): Proposed canonical SKUs: 
- redwood-base-subscription
- redwood-dedicated-addon
- redwood-private-vpc-addon
Trial plan: 14-day auto-activate trial for base SKU, no trial for addons. We'll use feature gating for private/dedicated. I'll attach a sample SKU mapping JSON.

Julia (Marketing): For listing creative we need: primary logo SVG, dark/light variants, 600x400 hero image, screenshot of Console showing latency/cost dashboard (mocked allowed), and a short 280-char description for each marketplace listing. Also need signed permission if we use vendor co-marks. I can help craft the 280-char blurb if you drop bullet points.

PublishBot: Staging artifact bundle created: https://internal.redwood/marketplace/staging/1768889999 - contains placeholder logos, SKU mapping draft, packaging README, and pricebook template.

Vik (Cloud Ops): Note re: container vs VM images: publishing a container (GCR/ACR/ECR images) simplifies cross-cloud but some vendors still expect VM/AMI listings for "Bring Your Own VM" offerings. We could publish both: container image for GCP & Azure, AMI for AWS. Also we need signed manifest + checksum for each artifact. Example command: `sha256sum redwood-container-v1.tar.gz`

Priya (Legal): Also confirm whether we'll include an automatic data pipeline to send anonymized usage metrics to our hosted analytics; that affects regional compliance. If so, flag during vendor review.

Nora (Partnerships): Action items:
- Vik: create staging publisher IDs + add marketplace-admins (Vik)
- Marco: upload SKU mapping JSON + sample pricebook CSV by Tue (Marco)
- Priya: review EULA + telemetry summary and respond by Wed (Priya)
- Julia: draft 280-char listing blurbs and upload marketing assets by Thu (Julia)
- All: confirm whether we use container images or VM images for each cloud (reply here)
Reply with :thumbsup: when you have the owner. If any dependencies with Sales/Support for entitlement flow, mention them now so we can include in packaging. Thanks!
